title: Coastal Crab Curry from scratch 🦀🔥 spicy & fiery #shorts

segments.moment_description: Returning from the market with fresh crab
Simmering the crab in the coconut-spice gravy
Enjoying the coastal crab curry dinner

description:
Coastal Crab Curry 🦀🔥 — fresh crab simmered in a fiery coconut-and-tamarind gravy with curry leaves and roasted spices. The kind of seafood curry that gets your fingers messy in the best way.

Crab curry with rice or neer dosa — what's your pick? 👇 Comment!

🌿 Made with fresh crab, coconut, dried red chilli, tamarind and a coastal spice blend — rich, spicy and full of flavour.

Did you know? Coastal crab curries lean on coconut and a souring agent like tamarind or kokum — the tang cuts the richness and balances the sweet crab meat.
